name: Easy EU Label
author: carlo66

sections.description:
Easy EU Label adds a clean, theme-adaptive EU General Product Safety Regulation (Regulation EU 2023/988 – GPSR) compliance box to your WooCommerce product pages.

Nothing is displayed on your storefront upon activation until you explicitly enter and save your real manufacturer, EU Responsible Person, safety instructions, and applicable certifications.

Key Features

  • Store Compliance Profile & Per-Product Overrides: Configure a storewide manufacturer and EU Responsible Person profile, override details on individual products, or hide the box on specific items.
  • Optional WooCommerce Store Import: Pull your existing real store name and physical address from WooCommerce settings with one click, without generating placeholder emails or unverified compliance claims.
  • Automatic 5-Language Frontend Translation: Built-in automatic translation for English (Default), Italian, German, French, and Spanish (compatible with WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress, and WooCommerce).
  • Auto-Adaptive Theme Colors: Automatically inherits your active theme palette or lets you choose from built-in presets.
  • Local Vector SVG Badges: Crisp local SVG icons for CE, RoHS, WEEE/RAEE, IP20, IP44, IP65, 5V SAFE, UKCA, REACH, and FSC, plus custom badges and PDF Safety Sheet links with zero external requests.
  • Flexible Placement: Display below “Add to Cart”, inside a dedicated WooCommerce product tab, or anywhere via the [easy_eu_label] shortcode.
  • Modern WooCommerce Ready: Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS), Cart/Checkout Blocks, Elementor, Divi, Bricks, Blocksy, and standard WooCommerce themes.
  • Clean Uninstall Option: Optional complete database cleanup upon uninstallation.

Separate Pro Edition

For multi-supplier stores that need unlimited supplier profiles, 1-click WooCommerce category bulk rules, or White-Label supplier masking for EU dropshipping, a separate Easy EU Label PRO plugin is available.

Legal & Compliance Notice

Easy EU Label provides structured display tools to help WooCommerce merchants present product safety and economic operator information under EU Regulation 2023/988 (GPSR). Installing this plugin does not constitute legal advice; the store owner remains solely responsible for the accuracy, verification, and regulatory completeness of the compliance data entered.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Easy EU Label from the WordPress Plugin Directory (or upload the easy-eu-label folder to /wp-content/plugins/).
  2. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  3. Go to WooCommerce -> Easy EU Label in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Enter your real Manufacturer / EU Responsible Person details, safety contact, and applicable certifications, then click Save.
  5. Optionally override compliance details or hide the box per product inside the EU GPSR Compliance tab of any WooCommerce product.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin display placeholder compliance data right after activation?

No. Nothing is shown on your storefront until you explicitly enter and save your real compliance details.

How can I place the compliance box inside Elementor, Divi, or Bricks custom templates?

Use the [easy_eu_label] shortcode anywhere inside your custom WooCommerce product template. You can also choose between displaying it below “Add to Cart” or inside a dedicated WooCommerce product tab.

Is Easy EU Label compatible with WooCommerce HPOS and Cart/Checkout Blocks?

Yes. Compatibility with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and Cart/Checkout Blocks is officially declared and verified across PHP 7.4 through PHP 8.4.

How does the 5-language translation work?

Frontend compliance labels automatically adapt to English, Italian, German, French, or Spanish based on your active WordPress or multilingual plugin locale (WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress).

Will my settings be preserved if I upgrade to Easy EU Label PRO?

Yes. Activating Easy EU Label PRO automatically deactivates the free Lite edition cleanly and preserves 100% of your store profile, badge selections, and per-product GPSR compliance fields.
sections.changelog:
1.5.3

  • Initial public release on WordPress.org.
  • Standardized internal easyeula_ prefixes with automatic, lossless migration from legacy keys.
  • Full WooCommerce HPOS and Cart/Checkout Blocks compatibility.
  • Built-in 5-language frontend translation (EN, IT, DE, FR, ES) and 10 local vector SVG badges.
  • Optional clean database uninstall setting.
